entities.name: Peema
entities.description: A vast wild, aether-rich forest on Avishkar, home to the largest elven community.

entities.name: Avishkar
entities.description: The plane on which Peema lies.

entities.name: Consulate
entities.description: The governing authority that treats Peema as a city.

entities.name: Elves of Peema
entities.description: The largest elven community on Avishkar, living in the trees and following the Elegant Design.

entities.name: Elegant Design
entities.description: The elven belief in harmony between nature and the aether flowing through the Great Conduit.

entities.name: Great Conduit
entities.description: Through which aether flows in the elves' belief.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: A city to which Peema exports food and wood.

entities.name: Great Aether Boom
entities.description: Event after which shipments of refined aether fueled new technologies.

entities.name: Vinday River
entities.description: River up which humans first settled Peema.

events.summary: Humans become the first non-elves to settle Peema, founding a riverside colony.
events.quote: Humans were the first non-elves to settle Peema, moving up the Vinday River and founding a riverside colony.

events.summary: Some elves collaborate with settlers while others return to resist outside influence.
events.quote: But not all elves welcomed the Consulate 's presence or the spread of urban life into their forest.

relations.note: Largest home of elves on Avishkar.
relations.quote: Peema is best known as the largest home of elves on Avishkar.
